steps.observation: You have 60 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism – European powers engaged in an arms race, building up massive armies and navies.  
2. Alliance system – Rival blocs (the Triple Entente vs. the Triple Alliance) turned a regional conflict into a continent-wide war.  
3. Imperialism – Competition for colonies and global influence fueled tensions among the great powers.
